title: Rejection probability as an expectation
statement: Let a nonadaptive tester have a finite seed space with probability law, query locations, and a deterministic acceptance rule. For any function supplied to the tester, its rejection probability equals the expectation over the seed of the indicator that the tester rejects.
hypotheses_covered: A nonadaptive function tester with finite seed space and a probability law
